PS I modified the title of my answer to metion Tk, and please share your improvements!

PPS succesfully tested the first demo ( [id://975624|updated version] ) with Perl 5.24 and SDL 2.546 incredible mixing capacities!!

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
